We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. Let's parse.

Facts: Defendant Xing (邢某) was accountant of a village group. In 2015 May, he was cash custodian. In 2015 May 5, a pre-allocated 1,000,160 yuan (100.016万元) expropriation compensation was to be managed. The committee entrusted Xing to keep the funds and distribute to expropriated farmers. On Sep 2, 2015, Xing embezzled (misappropriated) 300,000 yuan of the compensation, lending to Jiang (江某甲). On Dec 20, Jiang 2 (江2某) from the same area misappropriated 300,000 yuan from another person and returned the 300,000 that Xing had misappropriated. So basically Xing misappropriated 300,000 yuan of public funds (expropriation compensation) entrusted to him.

Thus the crime is "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds) or "挪用资金". In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "挪用公款罪". Since he was a public official? He was a village accountant, but the funds are public (expropriation compensation). The appropriate charge: "挪用公款罪". The examples earlier: For similar case, they used "挪用资金". In earlier example: "挪用资金". That example: "陈某利用其任湖北峡州国际旅行社有限公司...挪用...". They output "挪用资金". So we should output "挪用资金". The rule: Use the exact phrase from fact? The fact says "挪用其保管的本组征地补偿款30万元". So "挪用" is used. The crime name: "挪用资金". That matches earlier.

Thus final answer: [罪名]挪用资金<eoa>
